dedupe_keys.name: man0euvre case study 2 stochastic modelling of the nordic power system

description: Anders Arvesen, Siri Mathisen and Michael Martin Belsnes at SINTEF report Man0EUvRE Case Study 2. They pass a 2050 GENeSYS-MOD NECP Essentials capacity scenario to the stochastic FanSi power-market model and compare Norwegian hydropower flexibility, price-responsive demand, time-shiftable demand and added cross-border transmission. The report describes hydropower and time shifting as reducing intraday variability, while transmission reduces regional price differences and can expose Norway to greater continental price volatility. These stylised expansions are explicitly exploratory scenarios, not forecasts. Zenodo provides the report freely under CC BY 4.0. Coverage is Norway within northern Europe; related FanSi price outputs document weather years and time steps separately. The study uses the related European scenario collection. A limitation is that the report body, model execution and numerical comparisons were not checked.
